title: Mixbox Branding
subtitle: Mixbox Branding + app design
details: MixBox delivers premium cocktail kits designed to make everyone feel like a professional mixologist. For this project, I developed the complete visual identity, including brand strategy and logo design, built around capturing the motion and energy of mixology, specifically, the wave created inside a glass when ingredients are whisked together. This dynamic mark embodies the playful creativity of crafting cocktails while hinting at the premium quality of the experience. Paired with a bright, trendy color palette and elegant serif typography, the identity strikes a balance between fun and sophistication, reflecting MixBox's mission to make mixology premium, accessible, and visually exciting, ensuring every user feels inspired and empowered to create stunning cocktails with ease.
